data.long_meaning: Ashin is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots: Ash, meaning immortality, and Shin, meaning god. This name is believed to be a tribute to the divine power that bestows immortality. The name Ashin carries the meaning “Ash – Immortality, Shin – God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashin usually hope their child will grow to embody ash – immortality, shin – god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
